SMCI.thesis_one_line: Builds servers for AI data centres and is growing fast, but faces export-control investigations, weak controls and heavy cash burn at a price above what we can justify.
key_adverse_facts: SDNY indictment unsealed 2026-03-19 of co-founder/director Liaw and two others over alleged export-control conspiracy; SEC, SDNY grand jury and multiple BIS subpoenas outstanding; company not named or told it is a target (10-K FY26)
ICFR not effective at 2026-06-30 (IT general controls material weakness), second year running (10-K Item 9A)
FY26 operating cash flow -$6,809.9M and FCF about -$6.97B; inventory $12.9B; non-cancelable purchase commitments $34.2B; one customer 28.1% of sales
June 2026 equity raise: common at $27.50 and $4.3B 7.00% mandatory convertible preferred; ATM up to $1.25B; diluted share count 745M vs 599M in Jan 2026
Q4 FY26 gross margin 17.5% vs guided 8.2-8.4% and six prior quarters at 6.3-11.8%; revenue timing erratic (Q3 FY26 guide 'at least $12.3B', actual $10.2B)
data_conflicts: d4 FY27 consensus EPS $4.34 and NTM P/E 9.5 rest on Q4 FY26 peak margin; FCF yield -29.5% conflicts with 'cheap' value-factor reading
Yahoo basic shares 646.9M vs 745M diluted share count in company Q1 FY27 guidance; market value used 745M diluted
Sara Liu and Charles Liang Form 4s show identical 200,000-share sales (likely same jointly held shares; not verified)
Auditor-change history taken from Q12 triage, not re-verified in filings opened
SMCI.confidence_in_thesis: low: legal and control outcomes are binary and unresolved; demand evidence is strong but cash conversion is negative

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. My reverse DCF (12% cost of equity) implies 13.2% ten-year earnings growth vs my base 9.2%, so the price is above base; 9.5% at an 11% discount rate.

SMCI.scenario_basis: FY29 EPS 1.7/4.6/7.7 (bear/base/bull) x exit P/E 8/11/14 from $43.26; no common dividend; FY27 base NI $3.0B on 745M diluted shares.
kill_criteria: BIS issues a temporary or permanent denial order against Supermicro, or the company is named a defendant or target by DOJ/SEC/BIS (10-K: "has not been informed that it is the target").
The FY27 10-K (or any 10-Q) again reports ICFR "not effective", or any prior period is restated.
GAAP gross margin below 10.0% in two consecutive quarters (Q4 FY26: 17.5%; FY26: 10.8%).
Consolidated net debt (total bank debt plus convertible notes minus cash, company basis) above $3.0B at the Dec 31 2026 quarter-end (Jun 30 2026: about $1.2B), or quarterly OCF below -$1.0B again.
Quarterly net sales below the low end of guidance two quarters in a row (Q1 FY27 guide low end $14.5B).

DVN.thesis_one_line: One of America's largest shale oil and gas producers after absorbing Coterra, buying back stock at a price that only needs mid-cycle oil to work.
key_adverse_facts: Q2 2026 WTI averaged $92.47 vs $64.87 for FY2025; earnings and FCF are on a price spike (10-Q and 8-K)
Coterra merger closed 2026-05-07 (0.70 exchange ratio, $24.9B consideration); $14.1B of unproved properties acquired create impairment risk; asset-by-asset portfolio review under way
Also spent $2.6B on New Mexico federal leases in Q2; debt rose to $11.4B consolidated from $8.4B at Mar 31
FY26 full-year guidance 'unchanged from June' but the June guidance document was not in the SEC filings opened, so no verified prior range; no full-year guide from Feb to June
Senior turnover after merger: 5 legacy directors resigned, CFO and CAO replaced by Coterra executives, executive reshuffle 2026-08-20
data_conflicts: Yahoo/d4 shares 1.10B (rounded 10-Q cover) vs 1,150M issued on the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet; market cap $51.8B vs $54.1B
d4 FCF $0.78B (Yahoo) vs my TTM OCF less capex $4.69B; Yahoo appears to deduct lease/acquisition outlays
b1 factor history is pre-merger; asset-growth and net-issuance penalties reflect the merger
One Form 4 entry of 1,755,174 shares (~$52.7M) filed under the issuer's own name was not interpreted
DVN.confidence_in_thesis: medium: valuation needs only a $68 oil deck but the oil price, integration and synergy delivery are unproven

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. EV of $64.5B implies about 0% ten-year FCF growth at a $68 WTI deck (flat WTI about $72), below my 2% base, so the price is below base.

DVN.scenario_basis: Exit EV/EBITDAX 4.3x/5.0x/5.5x on WTI $55/$68/$82 (HH 3.0/3.5/4.0), net debt $10.4B, 1.15B shares falling with buybacks, dividends about $1.28 growing 5%, entry $47.05.
kill_criteria: Consolidated total debt minus cash above $12.0B at any quarter-end (Jun 30 2026: $10.4B), per the 10-Q/10-K balance sheet.
Company-reported run-rate synergies below $1.0B by year-end 2027 or 2027 capture below the $600M it guided.
Full-year 2027 total capital guidance above $6.3B with flat or falling production (Q3 2026 guide $1.4-1.5B per quarter).
WTI quarterly average below $55 for two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: $92.47).
Impairment of acquired Coterra unproved properties above $1.0B in any year.

MRK.thesis_one_line: A global drug maker whose cancer drug Keytruda loses patent protection in late 2028; the current price already assumes the pipeline replaces most of it.
key_adverse_facts: Keytruda was $8.37B or 50% of Q2 2026 sales; 10-K says biosimilar competition 'could begin in December 2028' and Keytruda is expected to be selected for IRA price-setting in 2027 (effective 2029)
Acquired-R&D charges of $9.0B (Cidara, Jan 2026) and $5.7B (Terns, May 2026) produced GAAP EPS of -$1.72 in Q1 and -$0.54 in Q2
Consolidated debt $53.9B vs cash and investments $8.4B (net about $45.5B); debt to total liabilities and equity 41.5% vs 36.0% at Dec 2025; $6.0B of new notes in May 2026
Pricing pressure: MFN agreement, Medicaid GENEROUS model, Germany GKV-BStabG law (from 2027), Januvia/Janumet -31% in Q2
Litigation: about 800 Dr. Scholl's talc cases, Gardasil MDL, Keytruda IRA suit against the government
data_conflicts: d4 NTM P/E 19.3 and FY26 consensus $2.74 include one-time charges; underlying 2026 EPS is about $8.64 (my arithmetic from guidance), about 17x
b1 earnings-yield and surprise percentiles are distorted by $14.7B of acquired-R&D charges
Yahoo FCF yield 4.1% vs my TTM FCF $16.1B / $367B = 4.4%; FCF excludes about $16.0B of 2026 acquisition cash plus Verona
Next earnings date 2026-10-29 from d4 only; no 8-K confirmation opened
MRK.confidence_in_thesis: medium: business quality is high and verified, but the valuation gap to my base case is wide and the cliff timing is set by patents

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Price implies 8.5% ten-year FCF growth (8% cost of equity) vs my base 5.2%; market value is close to my bull-case value of $159 per share, so implied is above base.

MRK.scenario_basis: Exit Sep 2029 on NTM non-GAAP EPS ex one-time charges of $6.3/$8.0/$11.5 x 11.5/14/17 plus dividends of about $3.5 a year, entry $148.78.
kill_criteria: Keytruda/Keytruda Qlex worldwide sales growth below 0% year-on-year in any quarter before biosimilar entry (Q2 2026: +5%; Q1: +12%).
Consolidated net debt (loans payable plus long-term debt minus cash and investments, 10-Q balance sheet) above $50B at any quarter-end (Jun 30 2026: about $45.5B).
A further single acquisition or licence with a one-time charge or cash price above $5B announced within the next 12 months.
Winrevair quarterly sales below $550M in two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: $588M).
Full-year sales guidance midpoint for 2027 below $66B when first issued (2026 guide $66.3-67.3B).
